_note: ラーメンの系譜。品目ハブ（/en/eat/ramen/）の横並び表と、各系譜ページがここから描く。cells は axes の key ごとの短い英語。status が published でも記事（en/eat/ramen-<key>.mdx）が無ければリンクしない。出典は各系譜ページの sources に置く。planned の行の era は、系譜ページを書いて出典が付くまで「—」のまま（記憶の年号を出さない）
name: Ramen

cells.soup: Pork bones boiled hard until white; salt or light soy seasoning
cells.topping: Spring onion, pork, wood-ear; ginger, sesame and garlic on the counter
cells.howToEat: Choose noodle hardness; order kaedama (a paid second portion) into the soup you keep

cells.soup: Stronger, thicker pork bone, cooked in a cauldron; yobimodoshi (never-emptied kettle)
cells.noodle: Straight, firm, slightly thicker than Hakata
cells.topping: Pork, spring onion, often pickled greens

cells.soup: Pork bone with chicken; finished with black garlic oil (mā-yu)
cells.noodle: Medium, firmer and thicker than Hakata
cells.topping: Fried garlic chips, pork, wood-ear, egg

cells.soup: Pork with chicken and vegetables; milder
cells.noodle: Soft, pale, made without lye water
cells.howToEat: Free pickled radish and a pot of tea at most shops

cells.soup: Light soy on pork stock; salt and back-fat versions too
cells.noodle: Flat, thick, wavy, very high in water (jukusei takasui)
cells.topping: Slow-cooked pork belly, sometimes covering the bowl (niku soba)

cells.soup: Clear soy on chicken and pork
Light soy on chicken and dried sardine
cells.noodle: Thin, wavy, high-water, hand-kneaded after resting

cells.soup: Miso; vegetables and mince fried in lard before the stock goes in
cells.noodle: Medium-thick, strongly waved, with egg, aged (Nishiyama type, 1955)
cells.topping: Bean sprouts, onion, pork; butter and corn optional, not standard

cells.soup: Clear salt on pork, chicken, kelp and scallop
cells.topping: Pork, bamboo shoot, a slice of wheat gluten (fu)

cells.soup: Soy on pork and seafood stock
Pork bone and soy, with chicken oil
cells.topping: Spinach, three sheets of nori, pork
cells.howToEat: Set richness, oil and hardness; wrap rice in the soup-soaked nori

cells.soup: Soy on chicken, pork and dried sardine
cells.topping: Pork, bamboo shoot, naruto, spinach, nori

cells.soup: Soy on chicken and small fish from the Inland Sea, with cubes of pork back-fat
Dark, sweet soy on pork bone (the 'brown' type)
cells.topping: Sweet-simmered pork belly, a raw egg
cells.howToEat: Eaten with rice, as a side dish
Pressed mackerel sushi and boiled eggs on the table, counted at the end

cells.soup: Very dark, salty soy with coarse black pepper
cells.topping: Pork, bamboo shoot, lots of spring onion

cells.soup: Pork bone and soy, heavy with back-fat
cells.topping: A mountain of bean sprouts and cabbage; garlic on request
cells.howToEat: Call out your extras when asked; a culture with its own rules

cells.soup: Served separately for dipping; the first was ramen soup with extra soy in a teacup
cells.noodle: Chūka soba noodles served apart; some shops sell several weights at one price
cells.howToEat: Dip the noodles in the soup, like a Chinese-style zaru soba

cells.soup: Served cold; the Sendai shop calls it 'ryanbanmen'
cells.topping: Tokyo's Yōsukō Saikan serves a five-colour version
